zh-CN.title: 玄奘西行求法路线
zh-CN.subtitle: 从长安出发的跨区域知识流动示意
zh-CN.shortSummary: 这条路线把长安、河西走廊、中亚和南亚放入同一研究视野，但不把所有节点都当作已证实的逐日行程。
curatorialDescription: 路线是对人物记录、历史地理和后世地图的综合 read model；每个节点都需要保留自己的证据层和置信度。
地图只画有现实地理指向的节点，传统叙事和圣迹内容会进入另一层。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补齐出发、返回、停留节点、路线版本和地图数据来源；当前只作为 Alpha 路线骨架。

en.title: Xuanzang's western pilgrimage route
en.subtitle: A schematic of transregional knowledge movement from Chang'an
en.shortSummary: The route places Chang'an, the Hexi Corridor, Central Asia and South Asia in one research view without treating every node as a verified day-by-day itinerary.
curatorialDescription: The route is a composite read model of biography, historical geography and later maps; each node retains its own evidence layer and confidence.
The real map draws only nodes with geographic referents; traditional narratives and sacred sites belong to another layer.
en.researchNote: Departure, return, stop nodes, route variants and map sources still need to be added; this is an Alpha route skeleton.

corridorNote.zh-CN: 仅列有据可考或可作为区域锚点的节点，不绘制伪精确逐日路径。
corridorNote.en: Only evidenced stops or regional anchors are listed; no falsely precise day-by-day line is drawn.
